page_title: BAY 4-3 HOL | Bayern Munich v Holstein Kiel 01/02/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+4' 0 - 1 The referee blows for the end of today's match.
90+3' 4 - 3 Goal! Steven Skrzybski (Holstein Kiel) was in the right place at the right time to get to the rebound inside the box and gleefully rifles the ball low inside the left post. It's 4:3.
90+1' 4 - 2 Steven Skrzybski (Holstein Kiel) scores a goal! He picks up a sweet pass and coolly slots the ball into the top right corner.
90' We will have 3 min. of added time.
85' Here comes a substitution. Adam Aznou (Bayern Munich) is brought on as a substitute for Raphael Guerreiro.
85' Timon Weiner makes a superb save to deny a header which was nodded towards the left-hand post by Jamal Musiala (Bayern Munich) after a cross from the side.

83' Serge Gnabry (Bayern Munich) bangs the ball towards goal from the edge of the box, but it's rising all the way and sails high over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Holstein Kiel will have a goal kick.
83' Here is a change. Phil Harres is going off and Marcel Rapp gives the last tactical orders to Andu Yobel Kelati (Holstein Kiel).
82' Substitution. John Tolkin makes his way off the pitch and Marko Ivezic (Holstein Kiel) comes on as his replacement.
81' David Zec (Holstein Kiel) commits a foul and is shown a yellow card without any hesitation from the referee.
78' Florian Exner shows a yellow card to Konrad Laimer (Bayern Munich) for his blatant foul.
76' Thomas Muller (Bayern Munich) makes his forward run a little too early and is caught in an offside position after his teammate tries to play a pass to him.
75' The referee blows his whistle for a foul after Leroy Sane (Bayern Munich) overruns the ball during an attack and makes an aggressive challenge on his opponent.
74' The attendance is 75000.
74' Lewis Holtby (Holstein Kiel) commits a rough challenge and Florian Exner blows his whistle for a foul.
71' Substitution. Lasse Rosenboom will be replaced by Jann-Fiete Arp (Holstein Kiel).
71' Corner kick. Joshua Kimmich (Bayern Munich) is ready to send the ball into the box.
70' Dayot Upamecano (Bayern Munich) rises highest from the corner and heads at goal, but his effort towards the top left corner is saved by Timon Weiner. It will be a corner kick for Bayern Munich.
70' Joshua Kimmich (Bayern Munich) goes over to take a corner kick after one of the defenders makes a good clearance.
70' Thomas Muller (Bayern Munich) gets on the end of a good pass and from mid-range he unleashes a decent strike, but the shot is blocked by the defender. Bayern Munich have a corner.

69' The keeper doesn't have to worry about this one. Finn Porath (Holstein Kiel) sacrificed accuracy for power, and thus his attempt went well over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Bayern Munich will have a goal kick.
67' Serge Gnabry (Bayern Munich) sends a cross into the box, but Timon Weiner comes off his line to gather the ball.
66' Thomas Muller (Bayern Munich) tries to send a pass but it's blocked.
62' 4 - 1 Goal! Finn Porath (Holstein Kiel) with a wonderful piece of finishing. He makes a yard for himself after a well-taken pass inside the box and strikes the ball into the top left corner.
61' Marcel Rapp has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Magnus Knudsen (Holstein Kiel) replacing Armin Gigovic.
61' The referee allows time for a substitution. Dominik Javorcek will be replaced by Steven Skrzybski (Holstein Kiel).
60' Florian Exner blows his whistle and it's Joshua Kimmich (Bayern Munich) who is penalised for an offensive foul. Good decision by the referee.
60' Joshua Kimmich (Bayern Munich) takes the corner and sends it into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence is ready and makes a good clearance.
59' Joshua Kimmich (Bayern Munich) delivers a promising cross into the box, but it's cleared. Bayern Munich force their opponents to concede a corner.
58' Vincent Kompany has decided to make a change. Thomas Muller (Bayern Munich) replaces Harry Kane.
58' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Kingsley Coman leaves the pitch and Leroy Sane (Bayern Munich) comes on.
58' Vincent Kompany has decided to substitute Aleksandar Pavlovic and he is replaced by Joao Palhinha (Bayern Munich).

56' The opposition back off Jamal Musiala (Bayern Munich), who needs no second invitation to shoot from inside the box. It's a decent effort towards the bottom right corner, but Timon Weiner denies him with the save.
54' 4 - 0 Goal! Serge Gnabry (Bayern Munich) pounced on a loose ball inside the box and beats the goalkeeper with a shot into the top right corner. He makes it 4:0.

52' This was a piece of cake for Timon Weiner. Harry Kane (Bayern Munich) found himself some space after latching on to a pass, but his strike only went towards the middle of the goal and into the gloves of the prepared keeper.
50' Joshua Kimmich (Bayern Munich) prepares to take a corner kick.

49' Jamal Musiala (Bayern Munich) does well to control a poor pass on the edge of the box then shoots towards the roof of the net. Timon Weiner is out of position but leaps to make a brilliant save. Bayern Munich win a corner.

46' 3 - 0 Raphael Guerreiro sends a superb cross into the box. Harry Kane (Bayern Munich) latches on to it and from close range plants a header into the top right corner, leaving Timon Weiner beaten. He displayed his eye for goal there - excellent finish. The score is 3:0.
46' Vincent Kompany has made a change at the break. Serge Gnabry (Bayern Munich) has come on in place of Michael Olise.
46' The game restarts for the second half.
45+3' 0 - 1 Florian Exner has ended the first half by blowing the whistle.

45+3' 2 - 0 It's a goal! Harry Kane (Bayern Munich) bursts into the box to get on the end of a whipped in cross from Kingsley Coman and scores magnificently from close range into the bottom left corner. 2:0.
45+1' Joshua Kimmich (Bayern Munich) lifts the ball into the box from the corner, but one of the defending players gets there first to head it clear.
45+1' A pass into the penalty area from Kingsley Coman (Bayern Munich) is intercepted by the defence. Bayern Munich get a corner.
45' 3 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
44' This corner kick is taken with a short pass by Joshua Kimmich (Bayern Munich).
44' Konrad Laimer (Bayern Munich) gets to the rebound just outside the box, but his attempt is blocked by one of the defending players. Bayern Munich force a corner. They send men into the box.
44' Joshua Kimmich (Bayern Munich) will try to find the head of one of his teammates from a corner kick.
43' Kingsley Coman (Bayern Munich) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge. Bayern Munich have been awarded a corner kick.
42' Kingsley Coman (Bayern Munich) starts his run too early and the referee blows for offside.
40' Another attempt to send the ball beyond the defence by Jamal Musiala (Bayern Munich) is thwarted and cleared to safety.
38' The resulting corner from John Tolkin (Holstein Kiel) only finds one of the defenders, who heads it out of danger.
36' Joshua Kimmich (Bayern Munich) sends the corner into the box, but Timon Weiner intercepts it and averts the threat.
36' Michael Olise (Bayern Munich) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away. Bayern Munich will take a corner kick.
34' Joshua Kimmich (Bayern Munich) takes the corner with a short pass.

33' Aleksandar Pavlovic (Bayern Munich) steadies himself and bends in a shot from the edge of the box towards the top right corner, but Timon Weiner has it covered and makes a comfortable save. Bayern Munich have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.

30' A brilliant individual effort! Michael Olise (Bayern Munich) tricks his way past challenges into the box and drags his shot narrowly wide of the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Holstein Kiel.
26' Lewis Holtby (Holstein Kiel) receives a sweet pass inside the box, but his effort on goal is blocked by the defender.
24' An opponent rises to his feet after being downed by Marco Komenda (Holstein Kiel). Florian Exner saw the sliding tackle and blows for a foul.
22' Joshua Kimmich (Bayern Munich) slides a pass forward, but one of the defenders cuts it out.

19' 1 - 0 Goal! Michael Olise shows great vision to find Jamal Musiala (Bayern Munich) with a cheeky pass inside the box, and his first-time shot is precise and sails into the bottom left corner. 1:0.
18' An attempted cross from Joshua Kimmich (Bayern Munich) is cleared.

15' Michael Olise (Bayern Munich) attempted to create a dangerous situation in front of goal by sending a cross into the box, but the defence easily dealt with the threat. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Holstein Kiel.
13' Joshua Kimmich (Bayern Munich) overhits the corner kick and none of his teammates can their head on it. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Holstein Kiel.
12' Dominik Javorcek (Holstein Kiel) is moving okay again after that injury scare.
9' Dominik Javorcek (Holstein Kiel) is having a really tough time right now. We are about to find out how serious his injury is.
8' The resulting corner from Michael Olise (Bayern Munich) is cleared by the opposition's defence.
8' Konrad Laimer (Bayern Munich) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack. Bayern Munich earn a corner.
7' Kingsley Coman (Bayern Munich) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.

6' Lasse Rosenboom (Holstein Kiel) makes a yard for himself on the edge of the box after picking up a pass, but produces a poor effort that sails high over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Bayern Munich will have a goal kick.
6' Michael Olise (Bayern Munich) hasn't suffered any serious injury which would see him leave the pitch. He's back in the game now.
4' Michael Olise (Bayern Munich) is writhing in pain and can now receive medical treatment after the referee signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
3' Joshua Kimmich (Bayern Munich) works the corner short instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.

2' Kingsley Coman (Bayern Munich) unleashes a powerful shot towards goal, but it is bravely blocked by a self-sacrificing defender. The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for Bayern Munich.
1' The first half has just begun.
The players are out and the match is about to start. Bayern Munich will have the kick-off.
Florian Exner was nominated as the referee for this game.
Show lineups We now know the starting lineups. You can find them in the match details of this match.
